pedagogical_depth.justification: Every lesson includes expanded_walkthrough naming a real Grade-1 SoR trap (letter-name interference, name-leakage, choppy-blend, freeze-at-unknown, integration) with concrete recovery moves. Pair gates and overall unit gate all passed at Level 4.

instructional_balance.justification: Each lesson follows minds_on / action / consolidation arc. Materials are entirely everyday classroom items (index cards, markers, picture cuts, counters); puppets remain explicitly OPTIONAL throughout. Capstone has 4-station rotation.

clarity_communication.justification: Voice consistent: Sounder Sam anchors every minds_on with the 'HOO knows the sounds? YOU do!' refrain; Blendy joins from L2. Vocabulary defined child-friendly. Success criteria all 'I can' phrased.

alignment.justification: Curriculum codes B2.1-B2.3 mapped lesson-by-lesson. Summative rubric covers all 3 with descriptors matching blueprint text byte-for-byte.

appearance.justification: Composite generation passes 0 placeholders thanks to smart_fallback + SOUNDER and BLENDY clipart entries.
